question.prompt: In quadrilateral \(ABCD\), \(AB\parallel CD\), \(AB=2x+1\), and \(CD=3x-4\) (unit: cm). What value must \(x\) take for quadrilateral \(ABCD\) to be a parallelogram?

solutions.explanation: One pair of opposite sides must be parallel and equal for the quadrilateral to be a parallelogram, so \(2x+1=3x-4\). Solving gives \(x=5\) (both sides are then 11 cm).
solutions.title: Parallel and equal opposite sides
